name: Deeper Deductions
source:
Play the role of young detective Miyu Mindbottom and use your detective skills and extrasensory powers to get to the bottom of the case!

Together, with her chatty inner voice Jiminy and the sharp forensic detective Lagarde Longtail, will Miyu succeed in figuring out the truth behind the death of the famous Dr. Daedalus Deiscoverer?

[From [url=https://zororowhite.itch.io/deeper-deductions]itch.io[/url]]
